novelty_at_synthesis_level: Compare an explicitly hidden, inherited aquatic stage state to adult chorus configurations, larval recruitment and subsequent maturation under changing hydroperiod; test whether direct stage information improves held-out biological predictions over weather and site history.
focal_question: When does the latent stage history of pond communities change which species call, survive and recruit after rain and drying?
